policySections.text: Bike helmets **cannot be returned once worn outside**, or after any impact, however small. Unworn helmets with tags and packaging can be returned within **60 days**. A helmet that was in a crash may qualify for our **Crash Replacement** discount; see **Warranty Overview**.

policySections.citation: Returns Policy › Condition of returned items
policySections.text:
Returned items must be:
- Unused, unwashed and free of wear outside the home.
- In their original packaging, with all tags, labels and accessories attached.

Items that come back used or incomplete may be refused or refunded only in part. Some categories have stricter rules; see **Returns Exceptions**.

answers.reference: Yes, if it is unworn: an unworn helmet with its tags and packaging can be returned within 60 days of the order date. A helmet can't be returned once it has been worn outside or after any impact, however small (Returns Exceptions › Helmets).
answers.answer: Yes, as long as it hasn't been used. An **unworn** helmet with its tags and packaging can be returned within **60 days** of the order date. Once a helmet has been **worn outside**, or after any impact, it can't be returned (Returns Exceptions › Helmets).

policySections.citation: Returns Policy › How to start a return
policySections.text:
1. Email support@adventureworks.example with your order number (shown in **My orders**) and the items you want to return.
2. We reply within 1 business day with a prepaid return label.
3. Print the label and drop the parcel at any carrier location.

You can only return an order once its status is **Shipped**. If your order has not been paid yet, cancel it instead; see **Order Cancellation**.

policySections.citation: Order Cancellation and Changes › When you can cancel
policySections.text:
You can cancel an order **until it is paid**. That means while its status is **Submitted**, **Awaiting validation** or **Stock confirmed**.

Once an order is **Paid** or **Shipped**, it can no longer be cancelled. Wait for it to arrive and return it under the **Returns Policy** instead.

Payment usually happens within minutes of checkout, so cancel as soon as possible.
